title: Evolutionary Adaptation of an HP1-protein Chromodomain Integrates Chromatin and DNA Sequence Signals
authors: Lisa Baumgartner; Jonathan J. Ipsaro; Ulrich Hohmann; Dominik Handler; Alexander Schleiffer; Peter Duchek; Julius Brennecke
one_liner_zh: 该文研究HP1蛋白Rhino的chromodomain通过单氨基酸突变G31D整合组蛋白修饰与DNA结合蛋白Kipferl信号，涉及蛋白-DNA互作的结构预测与功能验证，但非典型TF-DNA体系且方法以实验为主，AI/物理模拟深度有限。
abstract: Members of the diverse heterochromatin protein 1 (HP1) family play crucial roles in heterochromatin formation and maintenance. Despite the similar affinities of their chromodomains for di- and tri-methylated histone H3 lysine 9 (H3K9me2/3), different HP1 proteins exhibit distinct chromatin binding patterns, likely due to interactions with various specificity factors. Here, we elucidate the molecular basis of the interaction between the HP1 protein Rhino, a crucial factor of the Drosophila piRNA pathway, and Kipferl, a DNA sequence-specific C 2 H 2 zinc finger protein and Rhino guidance factor. Through phylogenetic analyses, structure prediction, and in vivo genetics, we identify a single amino acid change within Rhino’s chromodomain, G31D, that does not affect H3K9me2/3 binding but disrupts the interaction between Rhino and Kipferl. Flies carrying the rhino G31D mutation phenocopy kipferl mutant flies, with Rhino redistributing from piRNA clusters to satellite repeats, causing pronounced changes in the ovarian piRNA profile of rhino G31D flies. Thus, Rhino’s chromodomain functions as a dual-specificity module, facilitating interactions with both a histone mark and a DNA-binding protein.
abstract_zh: 异染色质蛋白1（HP1）家族成员在异染色质的形成与维持中发挥关键作用。尽管其染色质结构域对二甲基化和三甲基化组蛋白H3赖氨酸9（H3K9me2/3）具有相似的亲和力，不同HP1蛋白却表现出不同的染色质结合模式，这很可能归因于与多种特异性因子的相互作用。在此，我们阐明了HP1蛋白Rhino（果蝇piRNA通路的关键因子）与Kipferl（一种DNA序列特异性C2H2锌指蛋白及Rhino引导因子）之间相互作用的分子基础。通过系统发育分析、结构预测和体内遗传学实验，我们鉴定了Rhino染色质结构域内的一个单氨基酸变化G31D，该变化不影响H3K9me2/3结合，但破坏了Rhino与Kipferl之间的相互作用。携带rhino G31D突变的果蝇表型复制了kipferl突变果蝇，其中Rhino从piRNA簇重新分布至卫星重复序列，导致rhino G31D果蝇卵巢piRNA谱发生显著变化。因此，Rhino的染色质结构域作为双特异性模块，同时促进与组蛋白标记和DNA结合蛋白的相互作用。
